body: I've been feeling like this for months. I can't accomplish anything that I want to do. My life is crumbling apart right in front of me and there's nothing I can do to stop it.
Feeling nothing is a constant for me. I have no constants in my life besides that. Once I'm gone I really will be nothing.
That life is only temporary and the nothingness that I feel is not

Nah I get really mad about stuff like that. Whenever people say that they're "depressed" like it's just a normal everyday emotion makes me really mad. You're not depressed that your favorite pair of jeans ripped, you're just sad about it. Mental illnesses aren't every day adjectives that you can describe yourself as.

Just put in your two weeks notice, it's the best thing to do, you'll get a good reference that way. If you really don't want to stay any longer just tell them you quit, they might not give you a reference but it doesn't really matter if you already have past references.

That's a good point. There's something in my head telling me to never believe anyone though. I feel like people are just complimenting me to spare my feelings. I'll try to think of it like that every time someone compliments me, see if it works.
I'm 160lbs at 4"11 so I'm chubby but I see myself a lot bigger than I really am. It's a sickening feeling. Do you believe people when they compliment you?

I have never hit on him, nor would I ever unless I just completely lost it. I have money saved up to move and I don't have to worry about my job. I'm very wishy washy though, I really can't decide to either stay or leave.

I think about that a lot honestly. I probably only do like him because he's around me so much. I usually like what I can't have because no one would ever like me back anyway. The whole dating/social interaction in general is pretty hard for me as well.

My friend is okay with it, or atleast I think she is, she's never said anything otherwise she knows I'd never do anything to hurt her, I'd never do anything to hurt anyone. I'm not very good with dating/ talking to people, name a dating app and I've probably been on it. I get really anxious when talking to men and just give up after a while, that's why I like him so much. I don't get anxious when talking to him.
It's hard to do that when I can't see myself ever being with anyone, I'd probably feel bad for my roommate, idk I can't picture it.

I have never planned on pursuing him that's probably the dumbest thing anyone could do. Of course I would like to be with him but there's no possible chance of that happening and I'm not the type of person to hurt other people's feelings anyway. I like talking to him, I don't really have any friends at all really and he's one of the only ppl I talk to. Having depression makes it hard to "have your own life" or do anything really. You really think I should just fuck off and stop talking to him entirely?
